mentions.name: ravaan.art
mentions.description: This site showcases re-imagined and animated versions of classical paintings, created after the builder became obsessed with the idea from trying Grok Imagine. It is open-ended in direction, with the builder inviting feedback on what could be added.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ever since I tried grok imagine I became obsessed with the idea of re-imagining classical paintings or animating them so I created https://ravaan.art
